summary_md:
# Avsnitt 595 - Casemaraton

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-08-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 595 of Fill or Kill is a listener 'case marathon': the hosts go through tips from listeners and give each one a quick fill (yes) or kill (no). They like UiPath, Coffee Stain, CoinShares, Camurus, Logistea, Synka and Flexqube, reject the mining developer Grängex, and stay cautious on Freja and Intrum. The macro part covers Bessent's plan to buy back long US Treasuries, which they see as mildly supportive for stocks but not QE, plus the rebound in gold and crypto and Moderna's cancer-vaccine news lifting biotech and the host-owned Maravai.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 PATH — UiPath | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Given a fill; near all-time low, profitable, buybacks, agentic AI pivot; report 3 Sept.

#### Reasoning

Stock is down ~80% from IPO and valued like a legacy SaaS company, but it is profitable, has a large cash pile and is buying back shares. The asymmetry is that if its agentic AI business gains traction it gets re-rated as an AI company. The host is doing due diligence and they will follow up after the 3 Sept report.

#### Sell Triggers

- agentic AI growth fails to hold margins
- AI tools like Claude/Copilot take over its market
- weak 3 Sept report

> *"Vi slår till med en fil här så får vi följa upp efter rapporten 3 september."*

---

### 🟠 FREJA — Freja eID | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts buy the defence/NATO eID story, but long lead times and hard monetisation keep one host on the sidelines.

#### Reasoning

The Armed Forces contract and the need for a second eID alongside BankID support the thesis, and the stock is up 50% in a year. But it is the same story as in 2021-22 and they want a real earnings trigger first.

#### Sell Triggers

- no earnings trigger
- cannot find a way to charge customers

> *"Så jag sitter väl på läktaren på den här. Men alltså, jag köper storyn."*

---

### ⛔ GRANGX — Grängex | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Killed: no strong anchor owner and the build-out phase is usually costlier than expected.

#### Reasoning

Despite an NPV of 14bn against a 600m market cap and an Anglo American offtake, the host avoids mine developers without a strong owner because of dilution and cost-overrun risk until the mine is up and running.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong owner enters
- mine completed and producing

> *"Så jag säger kill men när väl gruvan står där, då Då börjar nästa fas."*

---

### 🟠 LOGI-B — Logistea | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trades below NAV of 17.8; one of the more interesting property stocks.

#### Reasoning

Discount to NAV plus pressure from Rutger's block sales. Management seems to do many things right, but the property sector has not turned yet, so they wait for a turn.

#### Sell Triggers

- property sector stays depressed
- continued block selling by major owner

> *"Men jag tycker absolut Logistea är ett av de mer intressanta fastighetsbolagen."*

---

### 🟢 COFFEE-B — Coffee Stain | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Given a fill; Valheim release 9 Sept is a trigger; low valued, misunderstood spin-off.

#### Reasoning

Spin-off selling pressure has left quality game titles undervalued, and it trades worse than Embracer. Triggers ahead: Valheim release, other launches, dividend and buyback.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak Valheim launch reception
- continued spin-off selling

> *"Så jag är lite sugen här. Det börjar dra ihop sig."*

---

### 🟠 NREST — Nordrest | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Founder-led with a defence food contract; has come down recently; report soon.

#### Reasoning

Strong track record, with the founder owning a lot and a growing defence contract. The stock has pulled back, though the founder has sold some shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- Armed Forces switches food supplier
- weak upcoming report

> *"Det känns ju som en tillväxtbransch. Försvarsavtalet. Det tycker jag är intressant."*

---

### 🟢 CS — CoinShares | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Scalable crypto ETF manager, buyback on the way, crypto hot again.

#### Reasoning

AUM and fees rise with crypto prices while costs stay flat. The called buyback plus the crypto rebound make it a very interesting way to get crypto exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- crypto rally reverses
- buyback not executed

> *"så jag tycker coinchef känns absolut som ett väldigt intressant alternativ om man vill ha exponering"*

---

### 🟠 FLEXQ — Flexqube | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Presumed Amazon deal, ~800% growth, first profit; robot logistics theme.

#### Reasoning

A strong ramp, but it is unclear whether the Amazon pilot will scale or be one of many tests.

#### Sell Triggers

- Amazon drops the pilot

> *"om de lyckas med det här Amazon-avtalet och om man ska rida den här humanoid robotgrejen så låter det superintressant"*

---

### 🟠 TPB — Turning Point Brands | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Pure-play white snus; host is waiting for FDA PMTA approval before buying.

#### Reasoning

Host strongly believes in white snus but will not buy before the binary FDA decision. Co-host warns the market is saturated and marketing-heavy.

#### Sell Triggers

- FDA rejects PMTA
- market saturation raises marketing costs

> *"den här aktien håller jag under bevakning och väntar väl kanske på det här FDA-godkännandet"*

---

### 🟠 CAMX — Camurus | **WATCH** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

CAM2029 readout in Q4 with $2bn peak sales potential; the share price has not moved yet.

#### Reasoning

Market cap 38bn, cash 4bn, EBIT 1.5bn in 2027. Host watches very closely and is weighing a position before the readout. A cited analyst says the stock could re-rate a lot on good data.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative CAM2029 Q4 readout

> *"Så Camurus håller jag väldigt mycket koll på och det blir väldigt intressant."*

---

### 🟠 STGO — Steppe Gold | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Gold stocks at 2-4x earnings after the gold revival; host prefers buying on dips.

#### Reasoning

Cheap valuation plus a ramp-up with the new mine, but the stock has already run.

#### Sell Triggers

- gold price reverses

> *"Köpa någon sond på Dipp tycker jag låter väldigt intressant."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host sold ahead of the report; anything could happen and the share issue is weighing on the price.

#### Reasoning

Could be fine long term, but short-term uncertainty ahead of the report means the host does not dare hold.

> *"jag har sålt mina aktier vågar jag liksom inte hålla"*

---

### 🟠 CNTB — Connect Biopharma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Binary study readout soon; listener claims +200% on a positive result.

#### Reasoning

Validated IL-4Rα target (same as Dupixent) and no approved biologic for acute asthma/COPD in the ER. Hosts stress it is a lottery ticket and people should read up first.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative study result

> *"Binärt. Reka någon och köpa inför en studie. som att köpa en lott."*

---

### 🟡 MRVI — Maravai | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host owns it: mRNA cap supplier with near-monopoly, profitability turned, takeover candidate with a VC owner looking to exit.

#### Reasoning

Moderna's cancer-vaccine success could drive large mRNA volumes that need Maravai's cap. The last two reports were good, the CEO is a deal-maker, and the five-year VC holding makes a bid more likely.

#### Sell Triggers

- VC rolls position into next fund
- mRNA volumes fail to materialise

> *"Jag har ägt den som en budkandidat. Att någon till slut tar in den."*

---
